entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard on IA No.7605/18, which is first application for suspension of sentence of petitioner - Ashok.

Petitioner has filed this revision petition against the judgment dated 13/10/2018 passed by 1st A.S.J., Jhabua, District-Jhabua in Criminal Appeal No.179/2016, whereby the learned appellate Court has affirmed the order passed by learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Jhabua in Criminal Case No.176/2011, wherein the petitioner was convicted under Section 16(1)(a) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and awarded the sentence of six months RI and fine of RS.1000/- with default stipulation.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the packet of biscuit which was found misbranded/ adulterated was manufactured in May, 2010 with the expiry of six months.
The sample was taken on 12/10/2010 and first tested by State Food Laboratory on 13/10/2010.
Report was received by the Food Inspector on 22/12/2010 and complaint was filed on 18/01/2011.

On the same day, notice was received by the complainant and in such situation, he could not avail his valuable right of examination of testing of second sample of the article alleged misbranded/adulterated article.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that petition is likely to take time for final hearing, the application is allowed and the jail sentence of the petitioner-Ashok shall remain suspended subject to his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rs. Twenty Five Thousand) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for their appearance before the Registry of this Court on 07.03.2019 and on such further dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry during the pendency of this petition.
List on the question of admission after 2 weeks.

(Virender Singh)
